# PC Dashboard v0.1.2

This release improves readability while keeping the graphite-and-teal hardware-monitor design.

## Changes

- Live GPU readings now appear beside memory, ahead of static device details.
- Per-core readings are easier to read and use three columns in narrow windows.
- Nearly full partitions show a clear low-space warning. Unavailable partitions remain explicit.
- Network transfer totals now count traffic since the app started. Current rates use steady-width numbers with smaller units.
- The default window no longer shows a scrollbar for a few pixels of overflow; smaller windows retain a subtle scrollbar.

## Windows download

Download **PC-Dashboard.exe** from the assets below. It includes Python and the required application libraries, so no separate installation is needed. Download **PC-Dashboard.exe.sha256** to verify the file. The [README](https://github.com/Arrantix/PC-Dashboard#download-and-run) has the verification steps.

GPU utilization is available through NVIDIA driver telemetry. AMD and Intel GPU utilization is not currently reported.
